ServicesPage.title: Technical service & help desk assistant for manufacturers
ServicesPage.intro: We use AI to answer the repetitive fault and documentation questions from your dealers, technicians and users from your own manuals, without replacing your existing software. That is all we do.
ServicesPage.processSubtitle: A simple, transparent process from first call to production.

ServicesPage.leadStep3: Production rollout: connected to your dealer portal, WhatsApp, email and service system, with team training and support.

Assessment.hubMetaTitle: Free AI Readiness Test | Huntay AzerTürk
Assessment.hubMetaDescription: How ready is your company for AI? Take the free 3-minute test to see your score and the first 3 steps to take. No sign-up.
Assessment.hubIntro: How ready is your company for AI? The test takes about 3 minutes; at the end you get a 0–100 score, a breakdown by area and the 3 steps to take first.

Assessment.disclaimer: This is a quick self-assessment, not an audit, certification or legal opinion. The questions are original and inspired by: {frameworks}. Thresholds are refined over time with real answers.

AiPath.title: Let AI answer your dealer and service questions
AiPath.subtitle: The data is already in your hands: manuals, service bulletins and past tickets. The assistant works with them, and your software stays as it is.
AiPath.pain1: Do your dealers and customers keep asking the same fault and how-to questions, tying your engineers up on the phone?
AiPath.pain2: Are manuals, service bulletins and price lists lost in folders, with only a few people knowing the right answer?
AiPath.pain3: Do new dealers and technicians ask headquarters about everything, with someone writing the same answer from scratch each time?
AiPath.step1Text: A short assessment call, then a report in 5 business days ranking the processes with the highest return.
AiPath.step2Title: 2. Technical service & help desk assistant pilot
AiPath.step2Text: An assistant that answers questions from dealers, technicians and users from your own manuals; live on one channel in 3 weeks without changing your existing software.
AiPath.step3Text: Once the pilot works, a production rollout connected to your dealer portal, WhatsApp, email and service system, with team training and support.
AiPath.proof: Across projects, help desk workload and response times improved by 30–70% and customer satisfaction by 15–40%, with a 10–30% improvement in costs and sales.

Expertise.title: Simple, stable systems that scale
Expertise.body: I build architectures without needless complexity that teams can build on with ease. In critical field systems, offline sites and AI products, I balance scalability, reliability and maintainability.
